question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
-- All 1777 purchase visits also have add-to-cart events. Good.
-- Now let me build the final query with the corrected purchase count logic.
-- "Left in cart" = added to cart but NOT purchased (visit had add-to-cart but no purchase)

WITH filtered_events AS (
    SELECT 
        e.visit_id,
        e.page_id,
        e.event_type,
        p.product_id,
        p.product_category,
        p.page_name
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE p.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
product_views AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_category, page_name,
           COUNT(*) as view_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 1
    GROUP BY product_id, product_category, page_name
),
product_adds AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_category, page_name,
           COUNT(*) as add_to_cart_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 2
    GROUP BY product_id, product_category, page_name
),
purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3
),
product_purchases AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_category, p.page_name,
           COUNT(*) as purchase_count
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT fe.visit_id, fe.product_id, fe.product_category, fe.page_name
        FROM filtered_events fe
        WHERE fe.event_type = 2
          AND fe.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
    ) p
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_category, p.page_name
),
product_left_in_cart AS (
    SELECT fe.product_id, fe.product_category, fe.page_name,
           COUNT(*) as left_in_cart_count
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT visit_id, product_id, product_category, page_name
        FROM filtered_events
        WHERE event_type = 2
    ) fe
    WHERE fe.visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
    GROUP BY fe.product_id, fe.product_category, fe.page_name
)
SELECT 
    pv.product_id,
    pv.page_name AS product_name,
    pv.product_category,
    COALESCE(pv.view_count, 0) AS times_viewed,
    COALESCE(pa.add_to_cart_count, 0) AS times_added_to_cart,
    COALESCE(plc.left_in_cart_count, 0) AS times_left_in_cart,
    COALESCE(pp.purchase_count, 0) AS times_purchased
FROM product_views pv
LEFT JOIN product_adds pa ON pv.product_id = pa.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_left_in_cart plc ON pv.product_id = plc.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_purchases pp ON pv.product_id = pp.product_id
ORDER BY pv.product_id
